method: 95% Wilson score intervals on fixed denominators; descriptive paired diagnostic comparison

absolute_recall_gain.definition: 81 newly detected phishing URLs divided by all 2000 phishing URLs

absolute_fpr_increase.definition: 53 newly flagged legitimate URLs divided by all 18000 legitimate URLs

interpretation: The intervals quantify sampling uncertainty for this cohort, not temporal/source uncertainty. DNS mutability and same-snapshot collection remain larger external-validity risks.
